audit_scope.method: Independent formula/specification review against card formula text and governing brief; five hand-worked cases per card (2 easy, 2 complex, 1 edge).
audit_scope.important_limit: The supplied files contain formula descriptions and types, not implementation source code. This deliverable cannot assert that the running implementation passes or fails; Claude Code must map and execute cases against actual functions. Some cases are conditional on exact enums/helpers noted in each card.
audit_scope.changed_flag_note: The Part 2 card source does not mark which functions changed since the prior audit, so changed_since_prior_audit is null rather than inferred.

executive_findings.finding: Numerical solver and bank-CD/broker-CD branching are high-risk; the card alone does not define priceAtYield coupon timing and bracket details. Validate against DEC-3837 and independent known-value cases.
Mutation/creation path must refuse the entire operation when any item value is unknown; must preserve metadata and never invent face value from market value.
Invalid/future user-entered history start must produce unreadable refusal without fabricated duration; date arithmetic and wording have many boundaries.
Signed negative balances make percentages exceed 100% or negative; exact-zero total has a separate zero-share/null-return branch. Test explicitly.
Zero-valued overrides must count as present; exact case-sensitive kind matching and provenance override rules are important.
The card’s inputs list mentions a fetched-price field, while its rule says last successful sync; verify implementation reads the intended timestamp field and uses an exact 4-day threshold.
Card taxonomy uses “Unclassified” but brief AssetClass type uses “mixed”; verify mapping and tests against actual runtime enum.
Missing face is aggregated as zero but must be disclosed separately; missing coupon-rate handling and average-yield eligibility need helper-level checks.

claude_execution_notes: Read the card file and governing brief; use the exact function names and signatures shown on each card, not invented calcFxxx names.
Find implementation and tests in repository; adapt fixture field names to actual TypeScript types without changing business semantics or expected values.
Where a case has conditional expected output or a note says inspect helper/enum, resolve it from actual source before executing and record the resolution. Do not silently guess.
Use fixed `now` values for date functions; avoid wall-clock dependence.
Compare numeric outputs with a documented tolerance appropriate to money/rates. Use exact decimal assertions for itemization; compare object fields and strings exactly where specified.
Report each case PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, actual output, expected output, source path/function, and reason. Never edit production code as part of the audit run.
Run integration tests for getAssetsState (uid isolation, absent document, empty list, storage errors) and reclassifyAccounts/buildItemizedAccounts mutation paths.
The audit review is not evidence that code has been executed. Attach actual run logs and do not call specification findings confirmed implementation bugs until a case fails.
